line: Ella Mai trippin’, we do a lot of that (A lot of that)
vault_lines: Ella Mai trippin', we do a lot of that (A lot of that)
meaning:
In this line, YG references R&B upcoming superstar Ella Mai, and her 2018 hit, “Trip.” On the track, Ella describes the way in which she is falling at her lover’s heels:

Baby boy, your love, got me trippin' on you

YG is likely feeling the same way about the girl that he is interested in.

line: Whoop, woo! Y’all already know who I am? Right? Mustard on the beat, ho Let’s go
vault_lines: Y'all already know who I am? Right?
meaning: Mustard includes this intro with vocals from both Quavo and YG. He has also used the identical part in his hit single “Pure Water” and in “Want Her.”

line: I got Mustard on the beat like a sandwich
vault_lines: I got Mustard on the beat like a sandwich

line: Sharpen up your knife ‘cause that pen’ life very scary
vault_lines: Sharpen up your knife 'cause that pen' life very scary
meaning:
This line can be viewed as a double entendre. The life in the prison or penetiary, also the pen, is dangerous, which is why it would be a wise descision to sharpen your knife.

A famous symbolic from literature is the ‘pen and the sword’. Living ‘that pen life’ in the way of being an artist and writing song with the pen draws a lot of criticism. Sharpening the knife can also implie the preparation of combat, in this case between Kodak and his criticists.
